run_when: A bookkeeping or accounting role may be open, or search results are available.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company is looking for someone to do its books: hiring a bookkeeper or accountant (full-time, part-time, contract or fractional), or asking publicly for a bookkeeper or accounting firm.
prompt.definition: Wanting the work off their plate is what the services ICP sells to.
yes_when: An open role for a bookkeeper, staff accountant or AP/AR, or a contract, part-time or fractional finance role
A public post asking for a bookkeeper or an accounting firm
no_when: Not applicable; use unknown when nothing is found
unknown_when: Only senior finance roles (CFO, VP Finance) with no bookkeeping work
watch_out_for: An accountant role at an accounting firm is that firm's own staffing (an exclusion), not a request for help
Job sites mix employers with similar names: a listing counts only if its employer is this company

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

queries: "{company}" bookkeeper OR "staff accountant" OR "fractional CFO" site:builtin.com OR site:ziprecruiter.com OR site:linkedin.com/jobs OR site:ycombinator.com OR site:wellfound.com
("{company}" OR "{founders}") "looking for a bookkeeper" OR "recommend a bookkeeper" OR "accounting firm"
good_sources: job sites (Built In, ZipRecruiter, LinkedIn Jobs, YC Work at a Startup, Wellfound)
